name: Paris
notes:
LitArbi 0.9.28-beta “Paris” (build 29) — Word add-in fixed.
• Fixes “Compile error in hidden module: LitArbiRibbon”: an early Windows build had installed the Mac version of the Word add-in, and later updates kept reinstalling it. LitArbi now removes it and builds the Windows add-in — if Word is open, you are asked to quit it first.
• Settings → Word Add-in → Check Word add-ins… shows which templates Word loads and repairs problems.
• Everything from build 26: full parity with macOS 0.9.28.
